ownership.upgrade: PreparingUpgrade retains that launch parent, all actual PreparedTransfers and both allocator-bearing arrays. Commit is atomic, only destination IDs enter bootstrap, and vector/child disposal precedes root completion. Abandonment retains all fields and original class.
ownership.cache: Reserve fixed slot/count before I/O, copy fallibly through the shared object boundary, verify signed name before allocation-free publication. ownership.seeding: Explicit not-found or a fully returned empty/oversized/invalidly signed image may authorize repair. IPC/I/O/attachment/snapshot/admission failures return error before repair. Current object-store and signing formats do not change.
